evidence: A safetensors file containing an empty float32 tensor loads successfully with safetensors.torch.load_file().
Calling safetensors.torch.load() on the same file bytes raises ValueError: both buffer length (0) and count (-1) must not be 0.
The traceback points to safetensors.torch._view2torch() calling torch.frombuffer(v["data"], dtype=dtype) on the empty tensor payload.
steps: Created a local virtual environment and installed torch and numpy from requirements.txt.
Used the local codebase sources via PYTHONPATH to import safetensors.torch.
Generated a minimal safetensors file containing a single zero-length float32 tensor.
Verified that load_file() returned the expected tensor keys and shape, then confirmed that load(bytes) raised the reported ValueError.
